what: The request's frozen-heads table keyed member heads by the frozen record's want bytes (a LibKey of the head task's own scope) while a body asked by the want its own unit's names made, and the head task named its cells a third way (head_cell, by text). Two member heads a body read were frozen again at a seed ('frozen now and not put: 2 a member's').
cost: a whole piece: a write-only lane cannot print which cells missed, so the profile line had to learn to name them first
cause: three names for one member head: the head task's cell (by text), the table's key (want bytes of the writer's scope), the body's ask (want of the reader's scope)
whys: the table was built as a plain map from want to bytes before head cells were named by text (lane EY), and nothing made the seed place a want the way widen places a read
class: a lookup keyed by a value one side computes in its own unit, where the other side's key is by text
prevention: done: a member head is found by engine_heads.rs Owners::place over the reader's names (the one placing widen and heads_of_crate use), its record read by the entry task's cell, which the head task's payload now carries; the profile names every member head frozen at a seed by path, want kind and why
annoyance: the lane cannot run the test that would print the two cells, so the fix is the design's and the line that names them is the evidence the coordinator reads
workaround: the profile line 'frozen now and not put: N a member's ...; first `path` (kind: why)'
